findings.quoted_text: in any event, other than claims covered by paragraph 8(b) or paragraph 6(a) of this agreement (which claims are excluded from this paragraph 9(f) limitation), the liability of VIP to BNL for any reason and upon any cause of action or claim in contract, tort or otherwise shall be limited to the amount paid by BNL to VIP in the twelve (12) month period prior to the accrual of the action or claim for the specific service which is the subject of the action or claim (or, if such accrual occurs during the first twelve (12) months of the initial term, then the liability shall be limited to the minimum fees payable by BNL to VIP during the first twelve (12) months of the initial term).

findings.explanation: Your liability cap excludes certain indemnification and confidentiality claims, leaving those exposures uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the total aggregate liability of the Contractor shall be subject to the agreed liability cap without exceptions that leave major obligations uncapped.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. Before we finalize the agreement, I wanted to suggest a small revision: - In the relevant clause, certain claims are excluded from the liability limit, which leaves those exposures uncapped. I propose modifying this section so that the total liability is subject to the agreed cap without exceptions that leave major obligations uncapped. Thank you for considering this, and please let me know your thoughts. Best regards,
